verdicts.verdict: SCAPOLITE is the system to keep. It is the only candidate that fits the decision on the boards where fit matters most: all five Tricks and every shelf in the shop, all three event choices at both sizes, all four rest choices, every Final Trick and both rarity plaques. Its cyanotype also holds a saturated Prussian-blue dark where the others go milky teal. Its losses are fixable: the settings frame runs off the bottom of the page, the atlas plans are faint under strike-through tabs, and Discoveries/How to play are clipped at the right edge. DIOPSIDE's atlas plans, settings containment and clubhouse docking cover those gaps and should be grafted. DIOPSIDE is a solid second but hides the shop shelves, the event's third choice at 1280 and stat labels behind rails or edges. CHRYSOPRASE hides wares and event choices behind 'More below' rails. GALENA made its boards fit by cutting what was on them: three Tricks, three Final Tricks, missing rest and event choices, no wing plans, and web-default buttons. It ranks last on every screen. No candidate reaches reference fit: coherence tops out around 7 and every board still carries flat tan web-style chips somewhere.

verdicts.verdict: SCAPOLITE is the only candidate that fits nearly every board around the large type. All five Tricks and both shelves are in view on the shop, all three event choices and all four rest choices show at both sizes, the reward's rarity plaques are clear, and the gameover shows every Final Trick plus the stat strip at 1600. It also keeps the most saturated cyanotype on the map. Its weak spots are the faint atlas plans, a settings frame that runs off the screen, the cramped Discoveries/How to play corner, and the 1280 gameover stats. DIOPSIDE has the best atlas plates, settings and clubhouse, but it shrinks badges on rest and hides wares, event choices and some gameover sections behind rails. CHRYSOPRASE fits less than DIOPSIDE. GALENA fits least of all: plaques bury the atlas, the shop shows three Tricks, the wing name is cut to 'T...', and the clubhouse buttons are plain web boxes. No screen reaches the samples' painted hand: there are no 9s and nothing fits between the samples.

STASH WARNING, please read: the main repo's stash entry "stash@{0}: On dev: pre-r59-merge grounding captures" is shared by every worktree. A `git stash; git stash pop` in my worktree stashed nothing, so the pop applied that entry to my worktree and conflicted on 12 tests/grounding PNGs. I reset those files in my worktree only. The stash entry is still there and was not dropped. Nothing in the main checkout was touched.

What changed:
- Atlas: ui/estate-blueprint.js PLACEMENT is now a plate of 3 columns x 5 rows of ranges, plus a foundation row (exported PLATE). Each plan is as wide as its range: grounds on the west, two house ranges, the Foyer at the south door, below stairs Crypt / Passages / Heart. The NE bay holds the key and the rose.
- drawMasterSurvey now draws a neat line, galleries across the gutters, a dotted garden wall, an L-shaped house wall and a foundation rule.
- atlas.js: the plate view draws each plan from the playable plan's rooms, halls, boss and safe rooms, and doors (planGrid), not a shrunken drawFloorplan. Names are one-line captions lettered in the gutter under each plan; the old plates/tags are hidden. _fitNames never wraps and skips "of ..." shortenings. _fitSheet pads are smaller. The dossier facts are a ledger, the tally is in small caps, the paper is lighter, the vignette is softer and the earned-wing brackets are tighter.
- tests/blueprint/estate.py still asserts the same seam, no overlapping insets, inside MASTER: PASS. Under machine load it needed longer navigation timeouts, applied in memory only.
- Shop: the five Tricks stand on one shelf at both sizes. The art window is shorter. Rules font is pinned to the old on-screen px through calc(var(--u)*N/var(--cpx)): 22.1 / 19.2 / 16.9 px at 1600, 21.4 / 18.5 / 16.3 px at 1280. Wares are three lots abreast. shop.js's inline grid-template-columns is overridden with !important.
- The rest of the shop's wares still sit under the "More wares below" rail at both sizes, but every Trick and every price is on the first screen.
- Gameover: four columns plus one stats strip. Final Tricks are two to a line. A ledger height (min(620px, ...), align-self:start) used to overflow; it now stretches. At 1280 it is three columns and the record panel scrolls inside itself; gameover.js adds a boardScrollCue for .go-stanzas, which reuses data-board-scroll="record". The old r51/r52 memorial tests may see two record cues.
- Reward: cards lifted, smaller crest.
- Event: at 1280 two whole choices; at 1600 all three with no rail. The moon glaze is .rm-ground::after with mix-blend-mode: color.
- Rest: all four choices whole.
- Settings: always three columns (except large text), all seven pages whole at 1280, 1600 and 1920.
- Map: CSS filter on .map-paper only (saturate / brightness / contrast / hue), and the tray sits lower at 1280.
